title: Criminology, B.S. (College of the Liberal Arts)
notes: University Park. Sibling of the already-built Criminology B.A. (CRIM-2026.json), reusing crim_catalog.json's already-fixed CRIM 12/SOC 12 -> CRIM 249 -> CRIM 250W prereq chain. Real difference from the B.A.: no World Language sequence, no B.A. Fields/World Cultures -- replaced by a mandatory STAT 200 (already common to both), plus a 21cr 'Option' (4 named options, each with real enumerated course codes: Business/Public Administration, Computing and Statistics, Legal Studies, Social Science Research -- so not a data-ambiguity wall). Picked Computing and Statistics for cleanest catalog reuse. Real hidden-prereq chain handled explicitly: the option's own prescribed SOC 470 needs SOC 207, which isn't otherwise scheduled anywhere in CRIM -- added SOC 207 explicitly, and narrowed the common 'SOC 1/3/5' requirement to literal SOC 1 (not the full 3-way OR) so the SOC 1 -> SOC 207 -> SOC 470 chain resolves deterministically regardless of which option the engine happens to pick first. Same 'Race/Ethnicity/Gender' and '4XX CRIM' generic-pool convention as the B.A. build (real open pools, not enumerable, same as CMPSC's own open pools). UPDATE after the prereq-parser fix: STAT 200's real prereq_groups require MATH 21 (which needs MATH 4, which needs MATH 3) -- none of which were anywhere in this plan, same real gap found in CRIM-2026.json. Added the MATH 3 -> MATH 4 -> MATH 21 chain explicitly (Semesters 1-3); this also unblocks the Computing and Statistics option's STAT 460/462/464, which all require STAT 200 (or STAT 240/250/401) as their own prereq. Also note: the freshly re-scraped crim_catalog.json now shows CRIM 249/CRIM 250W with empty prereq_groups (the CRIM 12/SOC 12 chain described above is no longer present in the on-disk catalog data) -- flagged for human review, not re-added here since catalogs/*.json is out of scope for this fix.
